item.name: Canonical Business Services
item.description:
Header-free twins of the Business Services routes (billing-canonical.yml): request metadata moves from X-* headers into `requestMetadata`, payloads sit under `data`, and errors answer as {responseMetadata, errors}.

Run-order coupling is inherited from the folder above and deliberately mirrored rather than silently fixed: the Business Services folder ends by deleting PT, which every later folder needs, and the id variables are only populated by the create requests. Run a folder against a fresh database, or skip the deletes, to see the green path. Verified: on a fresh database the canonical folders return exactly the same 27 status codes as their 3.0 twins, request for request.

NOTE — Postman prunes the body from GET requests by default: on import an exported cURL shows `--data ''`, and newman sends nothing, so the service answers 400 MISSING_HEADER requestMetadata.tenantId. This request sets `protocolProfileBehavior.disableBodyPruning: true`, which keeps the body on import and on send. Keep that flag if you copy this request.
